decision: Run exactly one source-complete stock-grid persistent Stream-K down-projection schedule at unchanged M32 and M384 consumers.

reversal_explanation.source: The rejected module changed stock M32 Shape<64,32,256> to <128,32,256> and stock M384 Shape<128,128,128> to <128,256,128>, halving output work units. The pinned stock M384 kernel is already a PersistentScheduler ping-pong kernel with Cluster<2,1,1>; stock M32 is a PersistentScheduler exact-row swapped kernel.
reversal_explanation.model_geometry: Gemma 4 31B gate/up is [M,5376]x[5376,43008] and down is [M,21504]x[21504,5376]. M32 down exposes only 84 stock output tiles after A/B swap. M384 down exposes 168 cluster-padded output tiles, a 132-SM wave plus a short tail.
reversal_explanation.h200_execution: H200 has 132 SMs. The stock M384 realization uses about 214 KiB shared storage and one CTA per SM, so persistent work granularity and tail balance matter. Widening output tiles reduces independent work and makes each persistent epilogue cover twice the output span. At M32 this mainly worsens underfill and weight/epilogue latency, measured as 34.064 us slower. At M384 the same change collides with an already residency-limited persistent grid and produces pathological serialized wide-tile service, measured as 4831.760 us slower.

arm.name: stock_gate_up__deterministic_streamk_down
arm.gate_up: Exact pinned stock dispatcher config for each M.
arm.down: Pinned sm90_fp8_config_down_streamk: Shape<128,128,128>, Cluster<2,1,1>, cooperative FP8 fast-accum, StreamKScheduler, deterministic reduction.
arm.material_difference: Changes persistent K-work decomposition only; it does not widen output tiles or reduce stock tensor-core/grid parallelism.

predicted_physical_change: The down projection will expose a full persistent work queue by splitting K=21504: M32 should rise from 84 independent output tiles toward 132 useful SM work partitions, while M384 should replace its 132-plus-36 output-tile tail with better-balanced deterministic K partitions.
quality_gate: Every gate/up, activation, requantization, scale, and final BF16 tensor must be finite and bitwise equal; eager and CUDA-graph replay must agree.
performance_gate: Alternating paired stock/candidate measurements at both M32 and M384; only a positive paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound at both shapes admits later endpoint work.
artifact_contract: Content-addressed source/build identity, immutable module, raw build logs, CUDA-entry marker, exact M32/M384 results, compact terminal, spend, and warm release evidence.
